title: Silk has another use
hook: The same material can serve different purposes.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The diagram shows a line attached to a surface and to the spider as it moves. Spiders can use draglines as safety lines, though silk use varies among species and situations; the example does not depict a measured fall.

misconception: Spiders use silk only for prey-catching webs.
objective: A spider attaches silk before moving away from a surface. In this example, what can the attached line provide?

claims.text: The same material can serve different purposes. A spider attaches silk before moving away from a surface. In this example, what can the attached line provide? Spiders can use draglines as safety lines, though silk use varies among species and situations; the example does not depict a measured fall.
